title: 馬克白 5-1 夫人夢遊
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: Lady Macbeth, a pale stately noblewoman with long straight black hair, piercing dark eyes, in a plain white nightgown, carrying a lit taper candle

panels.prompt: a cold stone chamber in a castle at night, a robed doctor and a gentlewoman waiting in candle shadow beside a curtained doorway, both leaning forward listening

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.text: 我陪你守了兩夜，什麼也沒看見。她最後一次夢遊，是什麼時候？
dialogue.en: I have two nights watched with you, but can perceive no truth in your report. When was it she last walked?

panels.prompt: {characters}, gliding down a dark stone staircase, candlelight hollowing her pale face, eyes wide open and unseeing

dialogue.speaker: 侍女
dialogue.text: 您瞧，她來了。眼睛睜著——視覺卻關著。
dialogue.en: You see, her eyes are open. Ay, but their sense is shut.

panels.prompt: extreme close-up of pale slender hands rubbing each other obsessively over a candle flame, faint dark stains on the skin that will not leave

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白夫人
dialogue.en: Out, damned spot! Out, I say!

panels.prompt: the doctor and gentlewoman exchanging horrified glances in deep shadow, the doctor's pen frozen above his notebook

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白夫人
dialogue.text: 可是——誰想得到，這老頭兒會有這麼多血？
dialogue.en: Yet who would have thought the old man to have had so much blood in him?

panels.prompt: {characters}, holding one small hand up before her face in candlelight as if smelling it, despair twisting her features, absolute darkness pressing in around the candle glow

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白夫人
dialogue.text: 這兒還有一股血腥氣。所有阿拉伯的香料，都不能叫這隻小手變得香一點。啊！啊！
dialogue.en: Here's the smell of the blood still: all the perfumes of Arabia will not sweeten this little hand. O, O, O!

quote.text: 所有阿拉伯的香料都薰不香這隻小手
quote.en: All the perfumes of Arabia will not sweeten this little hand.

panels.prompt: close-up of the old doctor's stricken face half lit by distant candlelight

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.text: 這一聲嘆息，多麼沉痛——她的心裡，蘊蓄著無限的悽苦。
dialogue.en: What a sigh is there! The heart is sorely charged.

panels.prompt: {characters}, whispering earnestly to an empty dark corridor, one hand beckoning to no one, the candle guttering

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白夫人
dialogue.text: 洗淨你的手，披上你的睡衣，別這樣面無人色——班柯已經下葬了，他不會從墳墓裡出來的。
dialogue.en: Wash your hands, put on your nightgown; look not so pale. I tell you yet again, Banquo's buried; he cannot come out on's grave.

panels.prompt: a small white-gowned figure receding up a vast dark staircase, the candle a shrinking point of light in blackness

dialogue.speaker: 馬克白夫人
dialogue.text: 睡去，睡去，睡去……事情已經幹了，就算了。
dialogue.en: To bed, to bed, to bed. What's done cannot be undone.

panels.prompt: the doctor closing his notebook with a trembling hand, the gentlewoman still staring up the empty dark staircase, both small in the cold stone chamber

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.text: 她需要的是教士的訓誨，不是醫生的診視。良心負疚的人，會向無言的枕頭洩漏他們的秘密。
dialogue.en: More needs she the divine than the physician. Infected minds to their deaf pillows will discharge their secrets.

panels.prompt: outside the castle wall at night, the distant campfires of an approaching army dotting the dark countryside like a swarm of embers

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 城牆之外，復仇的火，已經一堆一堆點起來了。
dialogue.en: Beyond the walls, the fires of revenge are lit, one by one.
